Our developers & Product Analysts got trained in IBM Garage methodologies to accelerate the transformation of American Airline’s application development. The Garage method excels at helping teams quickly design, build, and deploy an MVP to optimize the time to market. Operational excellence is key to the success of MVP. We emphasize on 100% test automation to get full code coverage.
LARGE AIRLINE
How can we modernize our legacy reservation management system?
Modernization Strategy & Build
Refactored large parts of the reservation systems from a monolith to microservices

CLIENT STORIES
The application was running on outdated technologies which could not support a mobile environment and had data integrity issues due to logic being split between code and stored procedures.
Renovo Solutions
How can we modernize a platform running on legacy technologies without disrupting its active userbase?
Modernization Strategy & Build
Partnered with end users to streamline application flow and consolidate business logic, eliminating conflicting rule sets that caused data integrity issues
Implemented coarse-grained, reusable code to consolidate and deduplicate business rules
Converted multiple applications to mobile responsive designs
Updated multiple versions to bring software versions back up to long term support
Eliminated legacy code that was causing confusion and extended development times
Enabled reduced maintenance costs by centralizing logic and componentizing user interface elements

CLIENT STORIES

Hulu was approaching the launch of Hulu Live TV and sought out West Monroe to guide their development teams and ensure a timely launch for both their iOS app 
and Apple TV app.
Hulu

Native iOS & 
Apple TV Design & Build
Modernization Strategy & Build

Our team co-located with the Hulu team in Santa Monica while working with their remote iOS team in Seattle. The two worked together to re-write their iOS app while building out their Apple TV app to support the launch of Hulu Live TV.
As part of the re-write, both apps were updated to use Swift instead of Objective-C. A reactive framework was introduced to better manage internal app state.
A significant update was also made to the iOS and tvOS CI pipelines to provide a faster, automated feedback loop for integration tests.
The team successfully rolled out the app to millions of Apple TV users and was able to make quick and efficient updates.

Legacy Apps Merged to 1

How can we modernize our tech stack and not require our users to multi-task between apps?

Performed an IT spend and resource benchmark and identified recommendations to address risks, scalability issues, and gaps in the technology portfolio, processes, and organization

CLIENT STORIES

The West Monroe resources that have been assigned to this engagement have been outstanding.
— Director, Software Engineering
Features Identified for Modernization
The features span ordering/fulfillment processes and enabling functions like client settings across multiple applications and tech stacks

The WM team has provided great value in the organization and knowledge they bring to the table.
— Sr. Director, Product Management

Client specializes in drug testing, employee background and occupational health screening, transportation compliance, and substance abuse training. Their dated monolithic architecture results in large, risky releases and presents challenges in upgrading specific domains.
Workplace Safety & Compliance Provider
How can we expand our occupational health offering while modernizing our architecture?
Modernization Strategy & Build
Performed an initial architecture deep dive phase to identify pain points and formulate an approach ahead of the build phase
Streamlined the implementation approach by instituting a more Agile design and development process than that of other vendors, significantly lowering the time to produce working, high-quality code
Split the occupational health domain apart from the on-prem monolithic back-end by creating a new .NET Core microservice and SQL database hosted in Azure
Currently revamping their current internal-facing and client-facing experiences, replacing ASP.NET web pages with React in the process

Will leverage Azure Data Factory to perform a one-time data migration to retire occupational health data in the legacy on-prem SQL Server database and have the Azure SQL database become the source of truth, updating downstream systems to pull from the new microservice
